why: The break rule and the hold were decided by two authorities with different rollback lifetimes; the split gave the simulation one ActiveConversation and made everything else a projection. Transcribed from the module's own docstring, not reconstructed from git.

Conversation continuity was the strongest extraction candidate in the actor monolith by every import measure — zero `use crate::` out — and the blocker was never the imports: features::FeatureInteractionSchedulePlugin owned every registration and interleaved three of its systems into one anonymous .chain(). Step 1.5 gave it its own plugin and named the cross-domain order as FeatureInteractionSet in shared_tangle, BELOW the monolith, so the vocabulary stayed reachable after the module left. What remained was a Cargo.toml: not one line inside the moved files changed shape, because use super:: resolves to the crate root exactly as it resolved to the parent module. The payoff is compile isolation for every edit that is not a conversation edit; the cost, measured, is one critical-path hop (12 -> 13) because the crate inserts a layer under ambition_dialog.
